payload.title: ADR-012 (messaging service) and ADR-013 (NestJS 11 upgrade) still declare Status: Proposed although apps/messaging-service exists and package.json depends on @nestjs/core ^11, so the new status rule reads both as records and no check compares an ADR status with the repository
evidence: package.json:207-209 (@nestjs/common and @nestjs/core at ^11.2.7, so the upgrade ADR-013 proposes is done)
CLAUDE.md:54 (the architecture map lists messaging-service as a running service)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:375-378 (STATUS_HEADER_RES accept Proposed followed by a parenthesis)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:405 (a header match makes the document a record; the header is never compared with the repository)
docs/architecture/ADR-013-nestjs-v11-upgrade.md:333 (names platform/event-bus, a directory that is platform/libs/event-bus in the repo)
CLAUDE.md:181 (known-drift note lists ADR-012 and ADR-013 as misfiled and tracks only their location)
payload.rule_violated: A document that answers confidently and wrongly is the defect doc-staleness exists to find (adapter header lines 4-6); an ADR whose status contradicts the shipped code is such a document, and DOCROLES ruling 1 makes it invisible to the only scanner.
payload.notes: Both ADRs spell a status the rule accepts, so a replay of the adapter functions at a81bfa2d6 counts them in recordDocs and reports none of their 11 missing paths (ADR-012 lines 1783, 1842-1844, 1905; ADR-013 lines 161, 175, 176, 179, 333, 404). Whether each of those rows is a claim is the owner's call; the headers themselves are wrong, since the service and the upgrade are shipped, and a reader of these misfiled ADRs (CLAUDE.md:181 tracks only their location) is told the decision is still open. ADR-038 line 20 is hidden the same way. Close condition: Set the status of both ADRs to the state the repository shows (Accepted or Implemented with a date), then run the adapter over them as live documents and repair or role-mark whatever it reports; proof is the adapter reporting zero findings for both paths with recordDocs not counting them. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
